PART 01

Quick Start Guide

The easiest place to begin — no figuring out the workflow on your own.

  • How to choose any story you'd like to turn into a comic
  • How to prepare it for the system
  • Which prompt to run first
  • How to stay organized start to finish
⭐ PART 02

Master Comic Creator Prompt

The main engine of the entire system. It guides the AI to build story structure, character development, visual style, page and panel planning, scene direction, expressions, environments, dialogue, narration and continuity — from any story you give it.

Structure Continuity Panel plan Camera
THE HEART OF THE SYSTEM
PART 03

Character Consistency Prompt

Solves the #1 problem in AI comics: a character that looks different on every page.

  • Builds a locked Character Bible
  • Face, colors, clothing, proportions
  • Reused as your reference every page
PART 04

Page Generator Prompt

Generate individual pages whenever you need them — action, expressions, camera angle, panels, dialogue and continuity, all in one page brief.

  • Generate → review → adjust → continue
  • No need to build the whole comic at once
PART 05

Comic Layout Prompt

Control how each page visually flows instead of repeating the same layout.

  • 2, 4 and 6-panel layouts
  • Cinematic layout for dramatic beats
  • Full-page layout for big moments
PART 06

Dialogue & Narration Prompt

Keeps beautiful artwork from feeling amateur because of clunky text.

  • Short, child-friendly dialogue
  • Clear narration that doesn't crowd the art
  • Less text. More storytelling.
PART 07

Matching Cover Prompt

A professional cover built from your finished comic — same characters, style, palette and mood.

  • Title placement guidance
  • Cohesive, book-ready composition

See exactly how it works

Every step of the system, followed start to finish with one real story.

demonstration story
"The Magical Treehouse"
1

Choose your story

Pick any story you'd like to turn into a comic — here we're using "The Magical Treehouse" as the example.

2

Run the Master Comic Creator Prompt

Generate the overall comic structure from the story.

3

Build the Character Bible

Lock the appearance of the children, the magical treehouse, and any supporting characters.

4

Generate individual pages

Use the Page Generator Prompt to create page-by-page comic instructions.

5

Choose comic layouts

Mix 2, 4, 6-panel, cinematic or full-page layouts depending on the scene.

6

Add dialogue & narration

Keep every page child-friendly and easy to read.

7

Create the matching cover

Generate a cover that visually matches the completed comic.

Final result: one cohesive children's comic, built from any story you choose, start to finish.
